adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` are passed directly into `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no validation/clamping. Since `.to_i` will produce negative integers for inputs like "-5", this can generate SQL with a negative OFFSET (and possibly LIMIT), which can error at the DB layer and return a 500. The diff also adds no spec coverage for these edge cases.
